task.pr_title: Allow running `download_devtools_regression_build.js` on a clean repo

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
I don't get it: why are we pushing a version to the packages here?

Isn't it will try to install packages like this:
```
npm install --prefix ... react-dom@x, react@x, react-test-renderer@x 16.3.0@x
```

where x is a `version`?

evidence.thread_resolution:
eps1lon: I was unconditionally adding `react-is`until I went down testing 16.0. And the AI gave me a silly completion 😄 
```suggestion
    installPackages.push('react-is');
```
